$description: Design tokens taken from the approved mockups. Dark theme only for v1. All values in px (= pt on iOS, dp on Android).

bgDotGrid.note: 1px dots every 14px on the screen background

accentRules: Only ONE accent-filled element per screen: the primary action (Start, Save…, Add to…, Finish).
Accent dot (6px) marks: active tab, LIVE, UP NEXT, records.
Never use accent for body text.

display.use: Big numbers and screen titles, never below 20px

label.use: Short UPPERCASE labels, units, small values; letter-spacing 0.06–0.12em

rules: UPPERCASE only for short labels (≤ ~5 words). Sentences are sentence case in Space Grotesk 13–15px.
Accessibility setting 'Dot-matrix numbers' off → replace Doto with Space Grotesk 500 for numbers.

safeArea.note: Use react-native-safe-area-context insets; the numbers are the iPhone 15 values used in the mockups.

components.DotBar: Progress as a row of dots: on = dotOn, off = dotOff. Calories 30–40 dots, macros 10 dots, rest timer ~24 dots.
components.DotColumnChart: Bar chart made of stacked dots (7px, 3px gap), 8–10 dots high, one column per week.
components.Chip: 44px high pill. Selected = surfaceSelected + 1px borderSelected. Unselected = transparent + 1px borderControl.
components.Segmented: Container 1px borderDecorative; selected segment = surfaceSelected + 1px borderSelected.
components.Toggle: 44×26. On = #F2F2F2 track, black knob. Off = black track, 1px #8E8E8E border, #8E8E8E knob.
components.Toast: surfaceRaised, 1px borderControl, radius 26, text + UNDO, pinned above the bottom bar, 5 s.
components.ExerciseImage: Square tile, radius 28% of size, #161616 with 1px border; dashed border + image icon when there is no image.
